name: @pipeworx/mcp-easypost

tools.name: easypost_rates
tools.description: Get shipping rate quotes from `<from_zip>` to `<to_zip>` for a parcel — returns multi-carrier rates (USPS, UPS, FedEx, etc.) with price, service level, and estimated delivery days. Example: easypost_rates({ from_zip: "94105", to_zip: "10001", weight_oz: 16, _apiKey: "your-key" })

weight_oz.description: Parcel weight in ounces, e.g. 16 for 1 lb

_apiKey.description: EasyPost API key (get one free at easypost.com)

tools.name: easypost_track
tools.description: Track a package by tracking number — returns current status, carrier, estimated delivery date, and recent scan events. Example: easypost_track({ tracking_code: "9400100000000000000000", carrier: "USPS", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: EasyPost API key (get one free at easypost.com)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-easypost forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the easypost pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
